messages:
emma: Quick notes from roadmap sync w/ two enterprise prospects. They asked: can we give a predictable isolation path that doesnt feel like a full replatform? Need a short tech+go-to-market plan.
ryan: TL;DR options:
  A) Soft isolation: per-tenant quotas + request shaping + logical kv namespaces
  B) Tiered pools: reserved slices (soft-affinity) for paying customers
  C) Physical silos: dedicated clusters (expensive, contractual)
jade: Requirements from sales: deterministic tail latency for SLA customers, EU data residency, and an easy upgrade path from soft -> hard isolation.
mike: Engineering constraints: batching and GPU memory sharing are the main cost levers. Soft isolation that still shares kernels is cheapest but leaks contention if not throttled.
chen: Measured overheads (rough): soft +12-28% depending on batching; tiered pools +35-70%; full silo 100%+ (varies by model family).
emma: Proposed MVP scope (narrow):
- Surface: API flag + Console toggle: isolation_mode: [soft, tiered] (default soft)
- Runtime: tenant_kv_namespace, per_tenant_concurrency, admission_control
- Observability: per-tenant latency histograms, cache_spill_rate, eviction_count
- Ops: pilot runbook, rollback triggers, canary traffic harness
ryan: Suggested launch gates:
- Functional: config APIs + console controls implemented
- Perf: P95 increase <= +30ms and P99 <= +60ms for pilot tenants vs baseline
- Cost: median uplift <30% for default soft config on standard workloads
- Reliability: no cross-tenant OOM propagation in >90% of chaos experiments
- Documentation: admin guide + sales one-pager ready
jade: Pilot plan: 4 tenants (dev, small-prod, mid-prod, enterprise) across 2 regions. 48h steady-state + burst tests. Validate upgrade path from soft -> tiered.
mike: Runtime knobs to add for pilot:
```
isolation:
  mode: soft
  per_tenant:
    max_concurrency: 40
    kv_namespace: tenant_id
  admission:
    burst_window_ms: 200
    steady_qps_limit: dynamic
  strict_cache_isolation: false
```
chen: For tiered pools we add: pool_affinity: high_iso -> capacity_ratio 0.25 and strict_cache_isolation: true. Also region_pin: eu-west when requested.
emma: Pricing ask: sales wants a two-tier model: soft isolation included, "Isolation Plus" for tiered pools + region pin as add-on (fixed monthly + % usage uplift). Keep messaging simple.
ryan: Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: policy combinator explosion. Mitigation: start with 2 modes and explicit upgrade path.
- Risk: opaque cost for customers. Mitigation: billing preview and per-tenant cost-trace in console.
- Risk: ops complexity on autoscaling. Mitigation: scheduler heuristics with isolation-aware packing and a fallback pool.
jade: Observability additions (labels): tenant_id, region, slice, model_family, isolation_mode. New events: cache_spill, forced_fallback, quarantine_trigger.
mike: Rollback rules (proposal): immediate rollback if sustained P99 > baseline+100ms for 5m OR error_rate > 0.75% for 3m. Otherwise auto-throttle tenants to keep cluster healthy.
chen: Privacy/security notes: for Private deployments we need explicit KMS isolation and key scoping per-tenant for tiered/physical modes. Add as enterprise checkbox.
emma: Delivery timeline suggestion:
- Week1: implement config + telemetry labels + console toggle (soft only)
- Week3: pilot infra + SRE harness + pricing one-pager
- Week5: roll soft isolation to GA and open paid pilot for tiered pools
- Q3: expansion for physical silos on contract
ryan: Action items:
- @mike: PR for runtime flags + admission control by Tue
- @chen: telemetry schema + dashboards by Wed
- @jade: pilot participant list + test plan by Wed EOD
- @emma: sales one-pager + comms draft by Thu
ci-bot: FYI: create RFC stub at https://redwood.infra/rfcs under 'tenant-isolation-path' when PR opened.
emma: Good discussion. Keep scope MVP-first. We'll use customer pilots to decide tiering economics before committing to physical silos. :rocket:
